s.how: Whisk 100g cornmeal, 100g flour, a teaspoon of baking powder and 250ml buttermilk to a thick batter. Pat 24 cocktail franks dry, push a skewer into each, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

s.note: Forky, made from a spork at kindergarten
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn, halved cherry tomatoes, diced cucumber and diced avocado with lime juice and salt. Spoon into little cups and stick a spork in each one. Whatever happens, do not throw the sporks in the bin.

m.how: Bake 1kg frozen thick-cut chips at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp. Heat 500ml beef gravy until bubbling. Pile the chips into 4 bowls with 400g shredded barbecue chicken, scatter over 200g torn fresh mozzarella and pour the hot gravy over so the cheese goes melty.

w.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 eggs, 250ml milk and a spoon of sugar into a smooth batter. Pipe in looping swirls into 180C oil and fry until golden on both sides. Drain, dust thickly with icing sugar and serve warm with sliced strawberries.

d.note: the hot day at the carnival
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Crush a handful of strawberries in a jug, add the juice of 6 lemons, the syrup and 1.5L cold water. Pour over ice in big cups. Exactly what a carnival should taste like.
